title: DTPBoundaryPredictor calls F.silu with two arguments — silu treats w3(h) as inplace flag, drops gating
trigger_conditions: BLT DTPBoundaryPredictor used for byte-level training
root_cause: The expression F.silu(self.w1(h), self.w3(h)) passed self.w3(h) as the inplace argument of F.silu (PyTorch interprets the second positional as a bool-coerced inplace flag). The intended SwiGLU gate (silu(w1(h)) * w3(h)) never executed, so the FFN computed silu(w1(h)) alone and the boundary predictor produced silently degraded outputs.
invariant: FFN must implement gated SwiGLU: out = w2(silu(w1(h)) * w3(h)); silu must be called with exactly one tensor argument.
diff_summary: Rewrite as h = self.w2(F.silu(self.w1(h)) * self.w3(h)) so the gate multiply runs.
